captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a road-bike triple crankset with concentric chainrings, left and right crank arms, and attached pedals. The assembly features a central hollowtech spindle with three dark-colored chainrings of varying diameters, each lined with outer teeth. A forged-alloy five-arm spider structure secures the chainrings to the right crank arm. Black rectangular pedals with silver-colored traction bars are attached to the outer ends of both crank arms.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a road-bike triple crankset using CadQuery. The design must feature three concentric chainrings with teeth, a right crank arm integrated with a five-arm spider, a left crank arm with a clamping end and pre-load cap, a central spindle, and two rectangular pedals with metallic traction bars.
captions.factory: The code constructs the crankset by first modeling the spindle as a cylinder and the bottom bracket shell as a larger outer cylinder. The three chainrings are built as thin circular disks with subtracted centers, decorated with radial tooth patterns using polar arrays of small wedges. The right crank arm and its five-arm spider are created by combining extruded 2D profiles and polar-patterned rectangular arms. The left crank arm is constructed similarly but mirrored and offset. Finally, the pedals are built as rectangular boxes with cylindrical pins and small rectangular traction bars, placed at the ends of the crank arms.
